description: Conditional logit (mlogit package): alt-specific intercepts (ASCs) for alts 2-4 vs alt 1, generic linear slope per attribute (CC,GN,...,HU,Price), all 20 attribute levels treated as continuous
notes: Not yet submitted to Kaggle. All attribute coefficients negative and significant except CC (p=0.38). Attribute levels (0-6 codes) treated as continuous/linear -- may be worth trying as factors (dummy per level) per standard conjoint practice, since there's no guarantee utility is linear in the level index. ASC for alt 4 (opt-out) strongly negative as expected given its lower baseline appeal despite being chosen 30.8% of the time in training subset -- this is absorbed by the intercept, not a contradiction.
